about.title: About Us
about.intro: Marián s.r.o. is a family business that has been selling premium imported woodcarving and woodworking tools in Slovakia since 2013. Our goal is to bring tools to market that you simply can't find in regular stores – tools that save carvers and DIY enthusiasts both time and money.
about.history: Our roots go back to 2011, when the Vercajch.eu project was founded; we took over all its rights in 2018. Today we run the shop under the eshop.marosko.sk brand, where in-stock items ship within 24 hours.
about.brands: We only stock proven international brands: Arbortech shaping and planing tools from Australia, Saburrtooth tungsten-carbide rasps from the USA, Manpa extension arms and milling attachments from Korea, and ARTU Tools carbide-tipped drill bits from Germany. Our range is rounded out with shellac, wood finishing waxes and certified protective work equipment.
about.philosophy: We personally put every tool we sell to the test before adding it to our range. Thanks to years of hands-on carving experience, we can judge not just its strengths but also its shortcomings – so we can give our customers genuinely honest, expert advice.
about.support: As a Slovak seller, we offer a full warranty, quality after-warranty service, and an invoice you can claim as an expense under industry subsidy schemes. We're proud to support Slovak artists and schools by making tools available that weren't previously accessible.

nastrojeDoUhlovejBrusky.title: Angle grinder tools for wood – complete overview
nastrojeDoUhlovejBrusky.lead: An angle grinder is one of the most versatile tools in the workshop – with the right attachments it can cut, hollow, mill, plane and even drill into wood without kickback. Our range includes over 330 specialized tools, organized into a few clear groups – from milling discs and needle rasps to attachments for stone, brick and plastics.
nastrojeDoUhlovejBrusky.brands: The range features trusted brands such as Arbortech, Manpa, King Arthur Tools, Saburrtooth, Kirjes, Silverline, Pferd, Sait, Prano and other established manufacturers – all designed for precise, safe material removal from hard and soft wood, plastics, OSB and PUR boards.

naDrevo.name: Angle grinder tools for wood
naDrevo.description: The largest group — the legendary Arbortech Woodcarver PROFI-INDUSTRIAL, the Turbo Plane planing disc, the Ball Gouge shaping tool and the Turbo Scraper 100 mm, milling discs from Akka Tools and Piranha, plus the Random Contour Sander attachment.

manpaRameno.name: Manpa extension arm and tools
manpaRameno.description: A complete Manpa extension arm system — the Multi Cutter Master with a spare cutter, a belt sander attachment, multi-purpose milling attachments, and 12 and 20 mm grooving cutter shanks for precise work in hard-to-reach spots.

diamantoveKotuce.name: Diamond sharpening discs
diamantoveKotuce.description: Diamond-coated grooved discs for sharpening chisels, knives, chainsaw chains, carbide (widia) tools and tungsten rods, plus wire-ring carriers and brush rings for brushing wood. The 2.5 mm thickness reaches between saw blade teeth.

nadstavce.name: Angle grinder attachments
nadstavce.description: Backing pads, adapters and M14 shaft extensions — a stand for the angle grinder, a keyless chuck, a diamond grinding nut, and M14/M22 and M14/6 mm reducers that expand what your angle grinder can do.

kamenTehla.name: Tools for stone and brick
kamenTehla.description: TURBO diamond cutting discs, diamond core bits from 22 to 68 mm, and Ø125 mm carbide grinding discs — attachments built for working masonry, brick and stone.

plastoveKompozity.name: Machining plastic composites
plastoveKompozity.description: A universal diamond cutting disc and Ø115–125 mm carbide grinding discs in medium and coarse grades, plus Saburrtooth needle rasps — specialized for sanding and cutting plastic and composite materials without overheating the surface.

nastrojeDoVrtacky.title: Drill tools for wood – complete overview
nastrojeDoVrtacky.lead: An ordinary drill can do far more than just bore holes – with the right attachment it becomes a mill, a sander or a sharpening tool. Our range includes 130 specialized tools organized into five groups, from Orbi Cut hollowing balls and sanding flap wheels to diamond sharpening discs and hollowing bits.
nastrojeDoVrtacky.brands: The range is rounded out by trusted brands such as Manpa, Kirjes, Wolfcraft and other manufacturers – built for precise hollowing, shaping and sanding of wood as well as sharpening other tools.

frezovanie.name: Milling tools for the drill
frezovanie.description: Orbi Cut hollowing balls and Manpa shaping cutter heads that turn a drill into a tool for hollowing and fine wood shaping.

brusenie.name: Sanding tools for the drill
brusenie.description: Manpa EZ-Sander flap wheels, drum sanders and sanding cones for fast, effective sanding of rounded shapes directly with a drill.

ostrenie.name: Diamond sharpening discs
ostrenie.description: Diamond-coated discs for sharpening chisels, axes, drill bits, glass and ceramics – precise enough for tungsten carbide rods too.

nastavce.name: Drill attachments
nastavce.description: Kirjes and Wolfcraft flexible shafts with a chuck up to 6, 8 or 10 mm, an M14 reducing shank, and mounting adapters that let you chuck tools originally made for an angle grinder into a drill.

vrtaky.name: Drilling tools and bits
vrtaky.description: Diamond core bits from 6 to 12 mm, square hollow-chisel bits for joinery, and centering bits for precise drilling and hollowing of wood.

nastrojeDoPriamejBrusky.title: Straight grinder tools – complete overview
nastrojeDoPriamejBrusky.lead: A straight micro-grinder (such as a Dremel, Proxxon or a professional straight grinder) turns into a precise tool for carving details with the right attachment. Our range includes shank-mounted burrs and needle rasps in five shank diameters – from a delicate 2.4 mm up to a powerful 6.4 mm – for both fine detail work and larger-scale wood shaping.
nastrojeDoPriamejBrusky.brands: The range features trusted brands Saburrtooth (Saburr USA) and Manpa – built for clean sanding and milling without overheating the material, with a long service life even under demanding carving use.

stopky24mm.name: 2.4 mm shank rasps
stopky24mm.description: Needle rasps and burrs with a 2.4 mm shank for Dremel, Proxxon and Parkside micro-grinders – flame, rotary-edge and internal-radius shapes, plus a 30-piece diamond burr set and Proxxon MICROMOT saw discs.

stopky3mm.name: 3 mm milling shanks
stopky3mm.description: 3 mm shank milling burrs in cylinder and pointed shapes, a 10-piece carbide burr set, radial bristle brushes (52 pcs) for cleaning and polishing surfaces, and a replacement Tuson flex shaft.

stopky32mm.name: 3.2 mm shank burrs
stopky32mm.description: The widest range of 3.2 mm shank tools – cylinder, bud, ball and cone shapes, Manpa toothed cutter shanks (round, square, triangular), an 8-piece Manpa burn-shaping rasp set, plus diamond burrs and mini HSS saw discs.

stopky6mm.name: 6 mm shank burrs and rasps
stopky6mm.description: Professional 6 mm shank burrs and rasps – Manpa SCR/SCS/SCT toothed cutter shanks, flame-shaped needle rasps in five coarseness grades, and rotary edges from 19 to 51 mm in diameter.

stopky64mm.name: 6.4 mm shanks
stopky64mm.description: Saburrtooth USA needle rasps with a 6.4 mm shank in a ring style, mandrel rollers for slip-on rasps, and a Manpa SCT toothed milling shank.

nastrojeDoMiniFrezky.title: Mini grinder tools – complete overview
nastrojeDoMiniFrezky.lead: A mini grinder (such as an Arbortech Mini Carver, Proxxon, Parkside or Makita) is a compact tool using 50 mm discs with a 9.5 mm centre bore. Our range includes five groups of discs and rasps organized by manufacturer – from original Arbortech accessories to Saburrtooth needle rasps and Merlin chain-cutter wheels.
nastrojeDoMiniFrezky.brands: The range features trusted brands Arbortech, Manpa, Saburrtooth (Saburr USA), King Arthur's Tools (Merlin) and the Czech manufacturer Idea Import (Ante) – all discs are built for precise, fast wood removal with a mini grinder.

arbortech.name: Arbortech accessories for the Mini Carver
arbortech.description: Original Arbortech mini milling discs for the Mini Carver series — the Mini Pro milling disc, a diamond milling disc, and sets of sanding and fibre discs for reliable, quality material removal.

ideaImport.name: Mini discs from a Czech manufacturer
ideaImport.description: Hand-cut Ante rasps from the Czech manufacturer Idea Import with a 10 mm bore and 50 mm overall disc diameter, a solid alternative to discs made for the Arbortech Mini Grinder and Merlin.

saburrtooth.name: Saburrtooth U.S.A. needle rasps
saburrtooth.description: Saburrtooth USA needle rasps with carbide teeth resistant to clogging — color-coded by grit (yellow fine, green coarse, orange extra coarse) for fast stock removal and fine wood finishing; not intended for metal or ceramics.

manpa.name: Manpa mini discs
manpa.description: Manpa toothed discs with a 50 mm diameter and 9.5 mm centre bore – quality, high-yield material removal.

merlin.name: Merlin mini rasps and chain cutters
merlin.description: Merlin (King Arthur's Tools/Kirjes) accessory discs and chain cutters for the mini grinder — a 4-tooth cutter for dirty wood, carbide mini rasps, and replacement 8-tooth Merlin and Oregon chains, also available separately outside the Nick Agar sets.

brusneVysekyNaMieru.title: Custom-cut sanding discs – complete overview
brusneVysekyNaMieru.lead: Custom-cut sanding discs let you match the sandpaper or cloth exactly to your sander's diameter – from tiny 50 mm discs for micro tools up to large 600 mm discs for professional sanders. All discs use a hook-and-loop backing, so they swap out quickly without gluing.
brusneVysekyNaMieru.brands: The discs are available in a wide range of grits, in both sandpaper and cloth versions, so you can pick exactly what fits the material and the level of coarseness you need.

maleVyseky.name: Small discs Ø 50 – 150 mm
maleVyseky.description: Compact round discs from 50 to 150 mm for mini sanders, random orbit sanders and micro tools – ideal for precise, detailed sanding, including 150 mm Silverline self-adhesive sanding discs.

strednePriemery.name: Medium discs Ø 180 – 300 mm
strednePriemery.description: Discs with a diameter of 180 to 300 mm for standard round and random orbit sanders working medium-sized surfaces, available in D40 to D120 grits.

velkePriemery.name: Large discs Ø 370 – 600 mm
velkePriemery.description: Professional large-format discs with a diameter of 370 to 600 mm for disc sanders and sanding tables, in D40 to D80 grits.

papier115mm.name: Sandpaper Ø 115 mm
papier115mm.description: Sandpaper with a 115 mm diameter and hook-and-loop backing, suited especially to angle grinders and medium-sized surfaces, plus fibre discs and a smooth fibre-disc backing pad.

podlozky.name: Backing pads and hook-and-loop accessories
podlozky.description: Foam interface pads between the backing pad and the disc (Ø 75 to 125 mm), and hook-and-loop backing pads sized to match your disc diameter, extending the life of both the abrasive and the sander.

elektrickeNaradie.title: Power tools for carvers – complete overview
elektrickeNaradie.lead: Power tools complement hand tools wherever you need faster, more forceful material removal – from straight grinders to multi-purpose grinders and dedicated carving machines. The range is organized by manufacturer, so you can quickly find spare parts and accessories for your machine.
elektrickeNaradie.brands: You'll find products from Arbortech, Extol Premium, Kirjes, Tuson, Proxxon, Silverline and Total – from Australian innovation to Finnish precision and affordable machines with long warranties.

arbortech.name: Arbortech tools
arbortech.description: Reliable power tools from Australia – the Power Chisel with a 7-piece chisel set, the Mini Carver cutter, the Allsaw AS200X masonry saw, and a compact mini grinder with a craftsman's kit.

extolPremium.name: Extol Premium straight grinders
extolPremium.description: Extol straight grinders for wood, metal, plastic and bone – suited for grinding, milling and deburring even in hard-to-reach spots, plus speed-adjustable angle grinders and a cordless mini straight grinder.

kirjes.name: Kirjes tools
kirjes.description: Power tools from the Finnish brand Kirjes focused on final finishing and surface treatment – a power unit and complete sanding systems with interchangeable sleeves and a flexible shaft.

tusonPriamaBruska.name: Tuson straight grinder
tusonPriamaBruska.description: A quality straight grinder from Tuson – good value for everyday carving use, with a flexible shaft attachment and a random orbit sander also available.

proxxon.name: Proxxon tools
proxxon.description: Proxxon electric tools and replacement belts – the LHW long-neck angle grinder, an electric chisel for carving details, and replacement belts for the belt sander.

silverline.name: Silverline tools
silverline.description: Silverline electric tools with a 3-year warranty upon registration – a 1200 W polisher, a 135 W straight grinder, and a telescopic straight-grinder stand.

total.name: Total tools
total.description: Affordable electric tools from Total – grinders, saws and polishers built for reliability, including cordless versions of the angle grinder, random orbit sander and chain saw.

akumulatoroveNaradie.title: Cordless tools – complete overview
akumulatoroveNaradie.lead: Cordless tools shine wherever an extension cord would hold you back – outdoors, in the workshop, or working on larger wooden structures. The range includes cordless grinders and chainsaws from Total.
akumulatoroveNaradie.brands: The range is covered by the trusted Total brand, built on a good balance of quality and price for cordless tools.

bruskyAku.name: Cordless grinders
bruskyAku.description: Cordless Total grinders for sanding and cutting materials on site or in the workshop.

pilyAku.name: Cordless saws
pilyAku.description: Cordless chainsaws and related battery accessories from Total for hobbyists and professionals alike.

rucneNaradie.title: Hand tools for the workshop – complete overview
rucneNaradie.lead: Quality hand tools are the foundation of every carving and joinery workshop. Our range includes files and rasps, carving chisels and knives, linocut and wood-engraving gouges, and carpentry chisels – tools built to last years of precise work.
rucneNaradie.brands: The range features trusted brands M. Stein and Stubai – Austrian and Slovak traditions of hand-forged tools made from quality carbon steel.

pilniky.name: Files and rasps
pilniky.description: Files for wood, metal and chains, diamond files, carbide rasps and sharpening stones – precise tools for sharpening and shaping, including a two-sided diamond sharpening stone and a 4-sided honing block.

dlata.name: Carving chisels
dlata.description: Professional carving chisels from Stubai and M. Stein – hardened, sharp steel for carvers, sculptors and engravers, available as individual profiles or in a starter 4-piece Stubai set.

noze.name: Carving knives
noze.description: Sharp, reliable carving knives for precise woodwork, suited to both beginners and advanced carvers – from simple straight blades to the curved Stubai knife.

rydla.name: Linocut and wood-engraving gouges
rydla.description: Gouges from M. Stein and Stubai suited to linocut, wood engraving and artistic work, with quality steel and comfortable pear-shaped or in-line handles.

tesarskeDlata.name: Carpentry chisels
tesarskeDlata.description: Quality carpentry chisels from Triton, M. Stein and Stubai for precise wood processing in carpentry work, in widths from 13 to 38 mm and variable profiles to choose from.

nateryTmelyBrusiva.title: Finishes, fillers, abrasives and wood treatments – complete overview
nateryTmelyBrusiva.lead: The right surface treatment protects wood and brings out its natural beauty. Our range includes shellac and stains, waxes and oil finishes, resins and fillers for casting, woodworm treatments, and materials for gilding and silvering.
nateryTmelyBrusiva.brands: The range is rounded out by thinners and degreasers for thoroughly cleaning the surface before applying a finish.

pozlacovanie.name: Gilding and silvering
pozlacovanie.description: Genuine gold and silver leaf (23¾ carat), edible Gourmet Gold, and water-based Decor Gold metallic paint – materials for artistic gilding and silvering of wood, frames and sacred objects.

protiCervotocom.name: Woodworm treatments
protiCervotocom.description: Professional Complet Antitarlo products (1 and 5 litres) for immediate eradication and preventive protection of wood against wood-boring insects.

riedenie.name: Thinning and degreasing
riedenie.description: Bioalkohol Uni and DEL Extra denatured alcohol for thoroughly degreasing and cleaning the wood surface, and for thinning shellac polishes, before applying a finish.

selakyMoridla.name: Shellac and stains
selakyMoridla.description: SONNE, BONA and white dewaxed shellac in flake form, waxed LEMON shellac, and ready-made ruby shellac polish for quality shellacking and staining of wood.

vosky.name: Waxes and oil finishes
vosky.description: Swedish organic KIRJES wax, beeswax paste and fragrance-free turpentine oil for waxing and oiling wood materials, bringing out the grain while protecting the surface.

zivice.name: Resins and fillers
zivice.description: Veropal epoxy resins for casting and stabilizing wood, acrylic Paraloid B72, and fast-drying Litostucco filler for repairing wood and plaster.

ochrannePomocky.title: Protective equipment – complete overview
ochrannePomocky.lead: Safety when working with carving and woodworking tools matters just as much as the quality of the tools themselves. Our range includes hand, body, face, respiratory and hearing protection, plus safety footwear.
ochrannePomocky.brands: The range covers complete protection from head to toe for carvers, chainsaw users and hobbyists alike.

obuv.name: Safety and work footwear
obuv.description: Quality safety and work footwear for all-day use in the workshop or on site.

ruky.name: Hand protection
ruky.description: Work, anti-vibration and cut-resistant gloves protecting hands from splinters and cuts.

telo.name: Body protection
telo.description: Overalls, waterproof suits, cut-resistant trousers and sleeves for safe work with carving tools.

tvarDychanieSluch.name: Face, respiratory and hearing protection
tvarDychanieSluch.description: Helmets, masks, respirators and hearing protection for eyes, airways and ears when working with tools.

nahradneDiely.title: Replacement and spare parts – complete overview
nahradneDiely.lead: Instead of buying a new tool, replacing a worn part is often enough. Our range includes genuine spare parts for Arbortech and Manpa tools – milling disc teeth, carbon brushes, belts and other components.
nahradneDiely.brands: Parts are organized by manufacturer so you can quickly find exactly the part you need for your Arbortech or Manpa tool.

arbortechDiely.name: Arbortech parts
arbortechDiely.description: Genuine Arbortech spare parts – carbon brushes, belts and replacement milling teeth for this brand's machines.

manpaDiely.name: Manpa parts
manpaDiely.description: Spare parts for Manpa Korea tools – a replacement part for the milling disc and a belt for the extension arm.

podstavceZveraky.title: Stands, clamping machines and vices – overview
podstavceZveraky.lead: Universal stands, clamping machines and vices make work easier wherever you need to firmly secure material or the tool itself. Our range includes carving vices, aluminum and plastic clamping holders for drills and angle grinders, extension holders and dovetail jig templates.
podstavceZveraky.brands: This accessory range comes in handy when working with smaller pieces and guiding tools precisely – it frees up your hands and improves cutting and sanding accuracy.

zveraky.name: Vices
zveraky.description: A swivelling bench vice, a compact 180 mm bench vice, and a portable Strongbold S1 stand vice with 10 kN clamping force – for securely clamping material when working with wood or metal.

drziakyNaradia.name: Drill and angle grinder holders
drziakyNaradia.description: Plastic and metal ProfiLine drill holders, an extension holder and a stand for the angle grinder – universal tool mounts for precise, comfortable work.

podpery.name: Work supports and stands
podpery.description: A work support with a tool tray, a Triton multi-stand, a metal adjustable trestle and an adjustable workbench – stable support for both material and the tool itself.

frezovacieSablony.name: Routing jigs and fixtures
frezovacieSablony.description: A Silverline dovetail jig, a Rockler universal router base and a Triton T4 pocket-hole jig – for precise tool guidance in joinery work.

drobnySortiment.title: Carving accessories and add-ons – overview
drobnySortiment.lead: A small but often indispensable range for everyday workshop use – replacement belts, carbon brushes, replacement blades, spare teeth for milling discs, cleaning blocks for clogged sanding discs, and nuts and adapters for angle grinders.
drobnySortiment.brands: These are practical add-ons that extend the life of your tools and keep them in good working condition.

brusneCistiace.name: Sanding and cleaning add-ons
brusneCistiace.description: Diamond dressing plates, a small sanding drum, and Kirjes cleaning blocks for restoring clogged sanding belts, discs and paper.

prislusenstvoBrusky.name: Angle grinder accessories and spare parts
prislusenstvoBrusky.description: Replacement Silverline sanding belts, an M14 shaft extension, and quick-release and universal M14 nuts for easily swapping angle grinder attachments.

carvingoveListy.title: Carving guide bars – overview
carvingoveListy.lead: A carving bar is a special chainsaw guide bar designed for shaping and detailed wood carving – suited to nose-cut work and safer thanks to a lower kickback risk. Our range includes Oregon bars in various lengths for both small and large chainsaws.
carvingoveListy.brands: Oregon carving bars are a trusted choice for carvers working with a chainsaw on site or in the workshop.

vodiaceListy.name: Carving guide bars
vodiaceListy.description: Oregon Sculptor guide bars in 25 and 30 cm lengths, a Makita 25 cm carving bar, and an OREGON sawyer's service kit for sharpening and maintaining chains.

retaze.name: Modified chains for tree surgery
retaze.description: Specially modified Oregon/Dolmar chains with different tooth counts for precise, safe work with a carving bar in shaping and tree surgery.

stopkoveNastroje.title: Shank-mounted joinery tools – overview
stopkoveNastroje.lead: Shank-mounted tools for a drill or pillar drill make joinery and carving work easier – from standalone knot cutters for removing knots to sets of shank-mounted burrs for shaping and finishing wood.
stopkoveNastroje.brands: The range includes knot cutters in various diameters as well as Silverline shank-mounted burr sets.

vzduchoveNaradie.title: Air tools – overview
vzduchoveNaradie.lead: Compressed-air-powered pneumatic tools offer high performance at a low weight – ideal for workshop and industrial use. Our range includes pneumatic straight and orbital sanders, a belt sander and a pneumatic chisel.
vzduchoveNaradie.brands: The range features trusted FORTUM and Silverline brands, complemented by a professional Gamma Zinken pneumatic chisel and air-line maintenance accessories.

pneumatickeBrusky.name: Air sanders and grinders

brands.title: Brands & Manufacturers
brands.subtitle: An overview of all the tool and material brands available in our range.
brands.intro: Over the years we've curated trusted manufacturers and brands that guarantee quality, durability and reliability in woodcarving and woodworking tools. Below you'll find an overview of the brands whose products we carry.

arbortech.description: Arbortech is an Australian brand founded in 1983, specializing in innovative power tools for carvers and craftsmen – the Power Chisel, Mini Carver, TURBO Plane, Industrial Woodcarver and Ball Gouge. It focuses on quality, ergonomics and precise wood shaping.

scraper.description: Scraper offers hand scrapers and tools for fine finishing and smoothing wood surfaces.

ideaImport.description: Idea Import.ante s.r.o. supplies tools and consumables for craft and woodworking workshops.

artu.description: ARTU Tools GmbH is a German company operating since 1979, specializing in carbide drill bits with a heat-resistant tip rated up to 1100 °C. The bits handle hardened steel, masonry, stone, glass and ceramics, with or without hammer action.

saburrtoothUsa.description: Saburrtooth is an American brand of rotary tools for shaping, cutting and grinding wood. Its patented open-pattern carbide teeth ensure fast material removal, long life and resistance to clogging – available as discs, rasps and mounted burrs.

akkaTools.description: AKKA Tools (AKKO) is a Turkish manufacturer of industrial tools founded in 1986, which grew from a small workshop into a modern 40,000 m² factory. The brand relies on state-of-the-art production technology and uncompromising quality.

kingArthurUsa.description: King Arthur's Tools is an American manufacturer of power tools and accessories for carvers, sculptors and craftsmen (since 1992), based in Florida and exporting to over 50 countries. It is known for its patented products Lancelot®, Merlin2® and Holey Galahad®.

silverline.description: Silverline offers a 3-year warranty on its products after registration, along with a wide range of available accessories and spare parts for its tool line-up.

tarpolProfesional.description: TARPOL Profesional makes rasp discs for angle grinders from hardened steel with a “B” safety certificate. It offers three coarseness grades and a wide range of shapes for wood, plastics, soft metals and aerated concrete.

tarpol.description: TARPOL is a Polish manufacturer of rasp discs and grinding tools for angle grinders, used on wood, plastics and soft metals.

magg.description: Magg offers tools and accessories for craft and home workshop work.

extolPremium.description: Extol Premium is a Czech brand (Madal Bal a.s.) of professional mid-range hand, power and cordless tools – hardened steel, durable motors and anti-vibration features.

oTools.description: O Tools offers hand and power tools for craftspeople and DIY enthusiasts.

sait.description: SAIT Abrasivi is an Italian manufacturer of grinding and cutting discs, abrasive cloth and paper, on the market since 1935. It ranks among Europe's leading abrasives producers for industry and craft.

triton.description: Triton Tools is an Australian manufacturer of professional power tools founded in 1976, focused on woodworking and metalworking – routers, sanders, table and mitre saws. It builds on precision, durable materials and patented solutions.

dolmar.description: Dolmar is a German brand of chainsaws, brushcutters and outdoor power equipment headquartered in Hamburg, part of the Makita group. Its tradition of professional forestry equipment dates back to 1927.

andrejIrsa.description: Andrej Irša is a distinctive Slovak sculptor — from realistic figures to abstract works such as Molecules, Entities and Spiralius. His work combines wood, metal, plastic and 3D printing, and he has authored expert publications on chainsaw carving, one of which serves as accredited teaching material.

oregon.description: Oregon is an American brand of saw chains, guide bars and chainsaw accessories, known worldwide in forestry and outdoor power equipment for its durability and cutting precision.

manpa.description: Manpa Tools is a South Korean brand (since 1988) making angle grinder attachments for shaping, gouging and texturing wood. Interchangeable carbide heads ensure a deeper cut, smoother surface and lower vibration during work.

tuson.description: TUSON makes a wide range of hand and power tools and workshop equipment with a great quality-to-price ratio, focused on functionality and reliability.

wadart.description: Wadart s.r.o. supplies tools and materials for woodworkers and craftspeople.

kirjes.description: Kirjes is a Swedish brand with a long history in wood sanding and shaping, offering a complete system – from rough shaping (Orbi Cut) through precision sanding with inflatable drums to fine polishing with organic waxes.

proxxon.description: PROXXON is a German brand of precision tools and mini machines for modelmakers, watchmakers and craftspeople – compact drills, mills, grinders and lathes.

lukas.description: LUKAS is a German brand of tungsten carbide burrs (rotary files) and grinding tools for metal, wood and plastic, known for the long edge life of its cutters.

nevada.description: Nevada offers tools and workshop equipment for craft workshops.

makita.description: Makita is a Japanese manufacturer of corded, cordless and outdoor power equipment founded in 1915, one of the world's best-known professional tool brands.

pferdTools.description: PFERD TOOLS is a German family-owned company operating in more than 100 countries, synonymous with high-quality, precise and innovative tools.

diplomat.description: Diplomat s.r.o. supplies tools and workshop equipment for craftspeople and DIY enthusiasts.

ctsItalia.description: C.T.S. Italia is an Italian brand specialising in chemical materials for restorers and art craftspeople – resins, consolidants and surface finishes.

ceraNovecento.description: Cera Novecento is an Italian brand with over 40 years of tradition (since 1985), producing natural beeswax-based waxes for treating wood, terracotta, marble and leather. The products enhance the natural beauty of materials with a subtle sheen.

deltaplus.description: Delta Plus is a French brand of personal protective equipment – workwear, footwear, gloves and safety gear for professionals.

lejaTools.description: Leja Tools makes cutting and shaping discs (e.g. the Multidisk) for angle grinders, used in wood carving and joinery.

madeInEu.description: Made in EU is a label for products manufactured within the European Union, guaranteeing origin and manufacturing quality standards.

m3.description: 3M is an American multinational corporation, one of the world's largest manufacturers of abrasives, adhesives, tapes and industrial products, with a strong focus on innovation and quality.

mstein.description: M-stein is a Slovak family brand with a 30-year tradition of hand-crafting professional carving tools. Its chisels, knives and gravers are made by traditional hand forging from proven Swedish carbon steel — every piece passes through the hands of experienced masters, from raw material to a finished tool with its characteristic octagonal handle.

holzmann.description: Holzmann is an Austrian brand of woodworking and metalworking machinery – band saws, planers, grinders and other workshop machines for professionals and DIY enthusiasts.

totalToolsCo.description: Total Tools is a global tool brand with over 20 years of experience, one of the largest tool manufacturers in China. The TOTAL line offers quality, affordable tools for DIY users, while the Industrial line steps up a notch.

hermes.description: Hermes is a German abrasives manufacturer with over 90 years of tradition, a direct competitor to brands like 3M and Norton. Ceramic grain and J-flex technology ensure high material removal rates and long tool life.

imperial.description: Imperial offers tools and accessories for craft and woodworking projects.

prano.description: Prano is a Czech brand of woodworking machines and tools for joinery workshops.

bibielle.description: Bibielle is an Italian brand of flap discs and non-woven abrasive materials for finishing metal and wood.

sochaMotorovouPilou.title: How to carve a sculpture with a chainsaw: step by step
sochaMotorovouPilou.cardDescription: From the log through chainsaw roughing to the final finish – a complete speedcarving process in eight steps.
sochaMotorovouPilou.intro: A life-size sculpture doesn't need a clay model – just a log, a chainsaw, and a simple sketch on paper. The process below shows how a female figure emerges from a log, from the first cut to the final finish, all within a single day. This is so-called speedcarving – a discipline where the sculpture is completed within a strict time limit, typically as a public demonstration at a symposium or festival.

steps.title: 1. Preparing the log
steps.body: We first strip the bark and level the ends of the log – especially the base, taking into account the sculpture's planned stance and the shift in its center of gravity. We stand the wood in its final position and use chalk to mark the first orientation cuts based on the sketch.

steps.title: 2. First cuts and the main axis
steps.body: The first cuts run almost the full length of the material, from both front and back. On the resulting flat surfaces we mark the main axis – perpendicular to the horizontal plane, passing through the future figure's throat notch. We redraw the straight outline in chalk and gradually remove the excess material.

steps.title: 3. Angular shapes
steps.body: At this stage the sculpture deliberately still has no rounded forms. Angular surfaces are far easier to check and measure than rounded ones, so we work on the whole figure at once rather than one section at a time. We keep refreshing the outline in chalk, already shaped more precisely than in the first cuts.

steps.title: 4. More precise cuts and openings
steps.body: The pieces of material being removed get smaller and smaller, and the cuts need to be more precise – a mistake here is hard to fix. We pause regularly to assess progress from a distance. We swap the large saw for a smaller one, and once the outer contours are satisfactory, we start on any openings, for example between the arm and the body. Small uncut bits can be knocked away with a hammer or a small pry bar, but only if it's a few fibers at most.

steps.title: 5. Details and the carving bar
steps.body: From this point on we mark not just outlines but also the position of details – the nose, ears, chin, fingers. A special carving (sculpting) bar is far better suited to this fine shaping than a standard guide bar: the tip of the saw lets you reach harder-to-access spots, cut curves, and work out finer facial and limb details with a lower risk of kickback.

steps.title: 6. Checking proportions and the angle grinder
steps.body: The closer the sculpture gets to finished, the more often we check the figure's proportions, stance, and the placement of details – rough work still allows small corrections, but that margin shrinks fast as the work progresses. Once we're happy with the shape, an angle grinder with a shaping disc comes into play, rounding off the angular surfaces and fine-tuning the anatomy to match real proportions.

steps.title: 7. Lower body, chisels, and marking the piece
steps.body: We don't forget the lower body, the back of the sculpture, or finishing the base – these spots are easy to skip but just as visible on the finished piece. Up to this point we've worked exclusively with power tools; now chisels get their turn too, playing a key role in the final fine-tuning. Just before completion, we can sign the sculpture in a suitable spot.

steps.title: 8. Sanding and finishing
steps.body: Finally, the whole surface is sanded with abrasive discs, and the sculpture is ready for finishing. For fine sanding of details like the face, fingers, or hard-to-reach folds, it's worth reaching for die-grinder burrs and rasps – they get exactly where a bigger disc can't. The finish itself can be layered: for example a colored base coat (thinned stain), which is sanded again once dry, followed by a final matte, colorless coating.

sochaMotorovouPilou.contextBody: Chainsaw carving is a sculpting technique in which a sculpture is created directly from a log using a chainsaw, an angle grinder, and chisels. Speedcarving refers to completing a piece within a strict time limit – typically within a single day or a few hours, often as a public demonstration. In Slovakia, the technique also has a tradition thanks to sculptor Andrej Irša, who is also the author of professional publications on chainsaw carving – one of which now serves as accredited teaching material. The same process described in this guide is used to create garden sculptures, life-size figures, and reliefs for public spaces.
sochaMotorovouPilou.closingBody: Planning your own sculpture? Our range includes carving bars for detailed chainsaw work, abrasive discs for the final sanding, and die-grinder bits for fine details. If you're not sure what to choose, reach us through the contact form or find us at eshop.marosko.sk.

knihaRezbaMotorovouPilou.title: Chainsaw Carving – A Handbook for Sculptors (2nd edition)
knihaRezbaMotorovouPilou.cardDescription: Andrej Irša's professional handbook on chainsaw carving – from understanding wood to workplace safety and pricing your work. Now in its second, expanded edition.
knihaRezbaMotorovouPilou.intro: The second, expanded and revised edition of Slovak sculptor Andrej Irša's successful handbook sums up decades of his experience with chainsaw carving – from understanding wood, through machines and tools, to work processes, safety, and pricing finished pieces.

sections.title: What the book covers
sections.body: The book takes the reader from the basics – types of wood, how they grow, harvesting, drying, defects, and processing – through a swatch of up to 100 wood species, styles and the history of woodworking, all the way to an explanation of art terminology and artistic anatomy. It also covers selecting and the evolution of machines and tools, work processes themselves, organizing events, workplace safety, caring for finished pieces, presenting and documenting them, and finally, pricing.

sections.title: Who the book is for
sections.body: The book is aimed at anyone interested in woodcarving and working with wood – professional sculptors and craftspeople, schools and hobby organizations, organizers of carving symposiums and workshops, as well as garden and cottage owners and chainsaw owners who'd like to put their saw to creative use.

facts: Length: 225 pages, 420 photographs, 68 drawings, charts and tables, 19 chapters, 229 covered entries
